turns.responseText:
BCR-ABL1 Campaign Safety-Potency Ranking — Ingests dual-assay IC50 data and produces a composite rank separating potent, cardiac-safe leads from hERG liabilities.

Input: 15-compound assay CSV with BCR-ABL1 IC50 (nM) and hERG IC50 (µM) for CPD001–CPD015, assay date 2026-03-15
Key steps:

Assay ingestion & normalization → parses long-format CSV, unit-converts all values to a common nM scale, flags hERG liabilities (IC50 < 1 µM threshold)
Composite scorer → computes selectivity window (hERG IC50 / BCR-ABL1 IC50 ratio) and weighted safety-potency score per compound → ranked compound table
Report generation → ranked_compounds.csv + interactive HTML report + JSON summary with pass/fail flags per compound


Expected output: ranked_compounds.csv (rank, composite score, BCR-ABL1 IC50, hERG IC50, selectivity ratio, safety flag), HTML report (visual rank table with color-coded hERG risk tiers), ranking_summary.json (top leads + flagged liabilities)

Decision gate: hERG IC50 < 1 µM → automatic cardiac liability flag (CPD003 @ 0.8 µM, CPD005 @ 0.9 µM, CPD009 @ 0.08 µM, CPD010 @ 0.05 µM ranked last); BCR-ABL1 IC50 < 1 nM + hERG IC50 ≥ 10 µM → Tier-1 lead (expected: CPD005/CPD006 ≈ Asciminib, CPD004 ≈ Bosutinib profile).

turns.responseText:
BCR-ABL1 CRO Submission Export — WuXi AppTec — Validates cardiac safety and formats all 5 ranked BCR-ABL1 compounds into a WuXi-ready submission CSV.


Input: 5 compounds with SMILES (Asciminib, Bosutinib, Imatinib, Gleevec-analog-2, Gleevec-analog-1), campaign ranking (#1–#5), IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), and composite scores from the BCR-ABL1 campaign


Key steps:

predict_admet_properties → validates hERG IC50 predictions against the >1 μM cardiac-safety threshold for all 5 SMILES
cro_submission_export → formats compound_id, SMILES, IC50 (nM), hERG IC50 (μM), composite score into WuXi AppTec column schema + computes RDKit MW/LogP
Safety filter → flags or excludes any compound failing the hERG cutoff before export



Expected output: wuxiapptec_submission.csv (5 compounds, WuXi-formatted columns) + metadata.json (MW, LogP, hERG pass/fail per compound) + HTML QC report


Decision gate: hERG IC50 > 1 μM required for all 5 compounds — any compound below this threshold is flagged and excluded from the final CRO export before submission.
